﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: hamcrest-library 1.3 -> 2.2

## Context

Project `jcabi-http` (by jcabi) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.hamcrest:hamcrest-library` from `1.3` to `2.2` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/jcabi/jcabi-http/pull/366

## Your Task

The source code is in `/jcabi-http`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
